LOGIN_CONSTANT.AGENTS_DESCRIPTION: Blocks Agents lets you create, configure, and deploy intelligent assistants without complex technical setup. Equip agents with RAG-powered knowledge bases, connect custom LLMs through MCP, define tools and guardrails, and embed agents into any frontend with a single script tag.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.AGENTS_SHORT: Create and deploy AI agents with RAG knowledge bases, custom LLM support, and embeddable script tags.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.AGENTS_TITLE: AI agents that understand your product
LOGIN_CONSTANT.DATA_DESCRIPTION: Blocks Data gives you instant GraphQL endpoints over managed or bring-your-own databases. Define schemas visually, enforce column-level validation and access control, and perform CRUD operations through the Data Playground.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.DATA_SHORT: Instant GraphQL APIs over managed or BYO databases with visual schema design, access control, and multi-provider object storage.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.DATA_TAGLINE: Instant APIs over any data operations.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.DEFAULT_OS_DESCRIPTION: Blocks OS is a modern platform for building and deploying secure, scalable applications with built-in observability, AI capabilities, and comprehensive identity management. Focus on your application logic while Blocks OS handles infrastructure, auth, and ops.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.DEFAULT_OS_SHORT: A secure plane for your application environment, secrets, and sensitive configuration.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.DEFAULT_OS_TAGLINE: Enterprise platform for secure, scalable applications
LOGIN_CONSTANT.IAM_DESCRIPTION: Blocks IAM is the unified identity layer for your entire application ecosystem. Configure enterprise SSO, connect external identity providers like Keycloak, Okta, or Azure AD, and enforce MFA from a single secure dashboard.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.IAM_SHORT: Unified identity and access management with SSO, MFA, role-based controls, and external IdP integration.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.IAM_TITLE: One identity layer for every app
LOGIN_CONSTANT.LOCALIZATION_DESCRIPTION: Blocks Localization is a key-based and context-aware translation service. Manage multilingual interfaces, edit translations in-browser in real time through the extension, and run bulk operations across thousands of keys.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.LOCALIZATION_SHORT: Manage multilingual interfaces with AI translation, bulk key operations, and a real-time browser extension behind secure RBAC.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.LOGIC_DESCRIPTION: Blocks Logic is a visual workflow engine for orchestrating complex operations without code. Drag triggers, conditions, and actions onto a canvas, fire workflows through webhooks or email, execute AI reasoning nodes, and push data through HTTP requests.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.LOGIC_SHORT: Orchestrate multi-step automations visually with drag-and-drop triggers, AI nodes, and external API integrations without coding.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.MONITOR_DESCRIPTION: Blocks Monitor delivers built-in observability without requiring external tooling or complex setup. Access real-time logs, distributed tracing, uptime monitoring, health checks, usage metrics, and AI-assisted diagnostics.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.MONITOR_SHORT: Get built-in observability with real-time logs, distributed tracing, usage metrics, and AI-assisted analysis. Zero setup required.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.OS_DESCRIPTION: Blocks OS is a secure, isolated, and fully auditable tenant-level core operating layer. It handles multi-tenant isolation, secrets management, audit trails, and sensitive log and trace handling while automatically logging every authentication decision, data access event, and configuration change.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.OS_SHORT: A secure plane for your application environment, secrets, and sensitive configuration.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.RELEASE_DESCRIPTION: Blocks Release provides end-to-end deployment infrastructure with security and compliance built in. Connect your repositories and the platform handles builds, runtime, scaling, and observability automatically.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.RELEASE_SHORT: Manage end-to-end deployment with git-based CI/CD, branch-environment mapping, and automated security scanning for ISO compliance.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.STUDIO_DESCRIPTION: Blocks Studio is an AI engine that transforms natural language prompts into working applications and reports within the Blocks ecosystem. It uses the same agent infrastructure to convert prompts into functional interfaces.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.STUDIO_SHORT: Generate working applications from natural language prompts within the Blocks context.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.STUDIO_TAGLINE: Generate AI-powered apps within Blocks context.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.UTILITIES_DESCRIPTION: Blocks Utilities provides powerful communication services for your applications. Send branded emails, deliver real-time in-app notifications via SignalR, and create secure time-limited magic links—both redirect and action-based—to power automated workflows.
LOGIN_CONSTANT.UTILITIES_SHORT: Send branded emails, real-time notifications via SignalR, and secure magic links to power automated workflows.
